GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
MINISTRY OF COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY
DEPARTMENT FOR PROMOTION OF INDUSTRY AND INTERNAL TRADE
OFFICE OF THE ECONOMIC ADVISER

PRESS RELEASE DATED 14th OCTOBER, 2026

Index Numbers of Wholesale Price in India for the month of September 2026
(Base: 2011-12 = 100)

The official WPI for all commodities for the month of September 2026 rose by 0.28 per cent
to 142.4 from 142.0 in August 2026.
